harmony.interpretation: Opening selected Ab begins during the preceding Fm harmony, before Bb arrival. Catalog Bb7 at0 is premature.

harmony.label: Bb7 / Bb9 color
harmony.interpretation: Bb/D with inherited F/Ab; explicit Bb/D/F/Ab voicing follows at+1.375. Brass/bass enter about.125 before Keyboard/Vocals; unify intentionally rather than treating micro-offset as different chords.

harmony.label: Gm7
harmony.interpretation: G/Bb/D/F. Bass G anticipates main Keyboard/Vocal arrival by about.625beat; exact anticipation is separate from harmonic block.

harmony.label: C7(b9)
harmony.interpretation: C/E/G/Bb/Db; preserve Db melody and altered dominant character.

harmony.label: Fm7
harmony.interpretation: F/Ab/C/Eb. Raw Vocal onset is+10.85, Keyboard/Bass approximately+10.88; chosen ensemble half-grid anchor corrects small drift.

harmony.label: Eb/G
harmony.interpretation: G bass with Eb/G/Bb upper harmony; do not replace with a G-root minor chord.

harmony.label: Abmaj7
harmony.interpretation: Ab/C/Eb/G. Vocal C sustains5.01875beats; this long arrival is essential to character.

harmony.label: Bb9sus4
harmony.interpretation: Bb/C/Eb/F/Ab. No D major third in the closing texture; preserve suspended ending.
